newsitem.title: CHINA: China develops colour liquid crystal displays.
newsitem.headline: China develops colour liquid crystal displays.

text.p: China has begun production of colour liquid crystal display (LCD) systems after three years of research by the Dalian Dongfang Computer Holding Company (Dongfang), the Xinhua news agency said.

The new Dalian Dongfu Color LCD Co in the northeastern city of Dalian was set up at a cost of $31 million by Dongfang, Dalian Development Zone Development Corporation and a Taiwan company, it said. The company broke ground on Monday, it said.
The designed capacity of the venture is one million 10.4-inch LCDs, 80 percent of which are for export, it said.
